Method of Attack: Impersonating legitimate organizations to trick users into installing fake apps
Stealing sensitive data such as bank account info, debit card PIN, PAN card numbers, and online banking credentials
Sending stolen data to attackers’ command-and-control server and a specified phone number
Intercepting one-time passwords (OTPs) and forwarding victims’ messages to attackers via SMS
Hiding app icon to run in the background without user knowledge
Attack Vector: Malicious APK files distributed via messages
Indicators of Compromise: Fake apps prompting users to enter sensitive data
Permissions to read and send SMS messages
